noAccess.title: Purchasing reports are not in your role
noAccess.body: Ask the administrator for the purchasing reports.

notInRole.title: Not in your role
notInRole.orders: The purchase orders of this company are not in your role, so no spend is shown.
notInRole.late: The purchase orders of this company are not in your role, so no late line is shown.

problem.read: The report could not be read. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: This report is not in your role.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: you may be offline.
problem.gone: This site or company is not there any more.

band.label: Report actions
band.mondayHeld: Scheduled e-mails of a report come later: print it or save the PDF meanwhile.
band.csvHeld: Waits until the panel is read.

section.late: Late lines and what they block

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.bar: Open the purchase orders behind a focused bar
keys.nextBar: In the purchase orders of a bar: the next or the previous bar

spend.hint: What was committed to suppliers with the purchase orders placed from {from} to {to}, at their value now; sample and development orders apart.
spend.failed: The spend could not be read
spend.emptyHint: No purchase order was placed with a supplier in this period: pick another period or site.
spend.barsHint: A bar opens the purchase order lines behind it (Enter on a focused bar).

kv.samplesHint: Apart: never counted in the production spend.
kv.amountsHeld: Shown only with the cost permission

spend.definition: An order counts in the month it was first sent to its supplier, at the value it holds now; a draft, an order waiting for its approval, a declined or cancelled order and a cancelled line are no spend; a line closed short counts what came; an order in another currency counts in the company's at the rate of the order.
spend.more_one: {count} more group is not drawn (it is in the total).
spend.more_other: {count} more groups are not drawn (they are in the total).
spend.incomplete: More lines than one report reads: the figures are of the first 20,000.
spend.mixed: Some orders have no rate in the company's currency: their amounts are written in their own currency, never added.
spend.noCost: Amounts need the cost permission: the bars and the table count orders and lines.

drill.title: POs behind this bar: {name}
drill.subtitle: Orders placed from {from} to {to}
drill.failed: The purchase order lines could not be read
drill.empty: No purchase order line in this group
drill.emptyHint: The figures may have changed meanwhile: close and read the report again.
drill.exportHeld: Waits until the lines are read.
drill.openHeld: No list filters purchase orders by category, company or month yet: open each order above.
drill.keys: J and K open the next and the previous bar.

late.hint: Open purchase order lines late, confirmed later than needed or not confirmed in time, ranked by the customer orders they put at risk, then the work orders, then the days late.
late.failed: The late lines and what they block could not be read
late.emptyHint: Every open purchase order line is expected in time.
late.emptyReason: No open line for this reason: show all.
late.tiles: Late {late} · confirmed later than needed {confirmedLate} · not confirmed in time {notConfirmed} · customer orders at risk {salesOrders}

held.send: Chasing a supplier needs the permission to send purchase orders.
held.status: This order does not wait for goods from its supplier: there is nothing to chase.

late.definition: A line is expected on its next delivery not yet received (the supplier's day, else the day asked); what it holds up is the demand the latest plan of its site counts on it.
late.noPlan: No plan has run for these sites yet: what a line holds up is not known.
late.incomplete: More open lines than one read takes: the first 5,000 are ranked.

chain.title: What {number} line {seq} holds up
chain.label: From the supplier to the customer orders of {number} line {seq}
chain.dueLate_one: Due {day}: {count} day late with this line
chain.dueLate_other: Due {day}: {count} days late with this line
chain.promiseLate_one: Promised {day}: {count} day late with this line
chain.promiseLate_other: Promised {day}: {count} days late with this line
chain.nothing: No work order or customer order of the latest plan counts on this line.

chase.subtitle: A mail on the order's thread, in the supplier's language: no price, no link.
chase.failed: What the chase would say could not be read
chase.ordersLabel: The orders and lines it chases
chase.noContact: The order has no active contact with an e-mail: choose one on the order first.
chase.mailLabel: The mail as the supplier reads it
chase.messageHint: Added to the mail before the request for new dates.

held.reading: Waits until the chase is read.
held.nothing: There is nothing to chase on this order.
held.long_one: The message is longer than {count} character.
held.long_other: The message is longer than {count} characters.

problem.changed: The order changed meanwhile: read the report again and chase once more.
problem.forbidden: Chasing this order is not in your role.
problem.nothing: No line of this order is late, unconfirmed or confirmed later than needed any more.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: the chase was not sent.
problem.send: The chase could not be sent.
